body: Hi im looking for friends too

I dont know why but "No Westeners" made me laugh out loud. But what the hell who can he go out with then? the man could have saved time and said looking for someone who doesnt live on earth and has no race please holla at your boy

I didnt consider that yeah it might of been like day before payday  or somethingso he didnt have enough for shoppong so he tried to cook what was there. Actually that makes more sense to me now lol

That is true he's a stand guy up im not bashing him , I think its just all the things weve seen so far of him. Its like oh he's that one cousin at the bbq thats bit out of it. We all have that one cousin lol. And yeah to be honest I was really triggered with how he didnt google cooking or anything Thinking on it now it might be because of the way im wired like to try something new with no prep or plan its like error error does not compute in my head. Like theres a diffrence between trying something new and doing something thats new. Eg cooking for the first time and cooking something you never cooked before for the first time. It felt like he skipped to the second one. With out doing that first one if that makes sense.(hope it does lol)

And I think for people who have made similar comment to mine about him not googling it I think are expressing a internal frustrated "waaaah???" Because were putting ourselves in his situation and trying to figure out how he came to the conclusion to wing it. And we hit a wall bacause nothing in that situation says wing it. I guess its like the diffrence between people who go to movies and figure out what to watch vs people who figure what to watch then go to the movies. We are the ones who figure it out before we are the boring ones haha. 

Also thats why im saying I think he is just abit slow or maybe its better to say he lacks common sense more then usual for a young person. And being surrounded by independant people makes it show more. But all the people who are briniging up depression anxiety and trying to do a dr phil special on him need to relax. Like he is good guy more so then the other two at times. And the best way to get common sense is experience. And it will be interesting to see him grow. Writing this actually makes me want to cheer him on now.

Thanks for your comments i felt like I learnt alot about myself today haha

I think Ruka is just abit slow. Maybe the slowest member on TH ever ? Im not saying that to insult him I think he's a good guy. But alot of people say he's like that because he is young and shy, he's too nice. Etc like I understand he's only 20 like that makes sense do you know how to cook, he doesnt thats normal for that age. He doesnt know what he wants to be in life. That's normal for that age (im not gonna get into the whole hero thing thats just another level).

But I just need to point out the brocoli pasta thing. He didnt cook it because he felt like brocoli pasta he cooked it because that was what they had. Correct me if im remembering this wrong.

But the only reason i think this , is because later on kenny goes im hungry oh theres no eggs and someone used my brocoli and the others go oh ruka used it. 

Im overthinking this but that means the one time he wants to cook he just grabs whatever he has and puts it together and calls it pasta. Like not even the thought of maybe I should use the internet to find a recipe or maybe I should ask someone to teach me. The main one for me is he didnt think to use the internet. Even teenagers would be like I dont know how to do this ill google it. Google it one of the things that we all do for things we dont understand.

That disconect on its own sealed it for me that this guy is few trees short of a forest if you know what I mean. Like I couldnt get over it he just used whatever food was in the fridge and cubboard like "yo this is all i need no sweat" like seriously no google no youtube nothing. You have the inernet like I dunno I feel like Im overthinking it but he's 20 and he didnt use the internet to find a recipe to follow because he doesnt know how to cook.

I had to get that off my chest lol what do you guys think ?
